In Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Order.UpperLower, several distance lemmas were stated specifically for finite products ι → ℝ, with a TODO asking whether they could be generalized to also cover ℝ and EuclideanSpace ℝ ι.

In #44072, we generalize these lemmas to any type α satisfying

[NormedAddCommGroup α] [Lattice α]
[IsOrderedAddMonoid α] [HasSolidNorm α]

The main observation is that the coordinatewise arguments are unnecessary once the norm is solid. For example, dist_inf_sup follows from the lattice identity relating

(x ⊔ y) - (x ⊓ y)

to |x - y|, together with norm_abs_eq_norm.

Similarly, the monotonicity and antitonicity lemmas for dist follow from norm_le_norm_of_abs_le_abs: the order assumptions allow the relevant absolute values to be rewritten as ordinary differences, after which monotonicity of subtraction gives the required inequality. The general dist_le_dist_of_le lemma is then obtained by combining these results.

To make the generalized lemmas apply to the original examples, the PR also adds HasSolidNorm instances for finite products ι → ℝ and for EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, as well as the necessary lattice and ordered-additive structures on EuclideanSpace ℝ ι.

As a result, the former _pi lemmas can be replaced by a single collection of lemmas that works uniformly for ℝ, finite products of reals, and real Euclidean spaces.
